# OpenDefendable · llms.txt

# Context manifest for AI agents indexing opendefendable.com.
# Last updated: 2026-05-25 (v0.1.0 brand-stack lock · Hedera anchoring doctrine cleanup · operator-entity unification)

## What this is

**OpenDefendable** is the open standards body for AI agent defense.

It is the OSS / contributor / standards-body surface in the Defendable
brand stack. Cisco · F5 · Check Point · CrowdStrike are shipping closed
AI-agent-defense products to the Fortune 500. The open ecosystem needs
a standards body the way software supply-chain security got OpenSSF.
OpenDefendable is that body.

## Mission

Publish the open standards anyone in the AI-agent-defense ecosystem
can build against · verify · and contribute to:

  - Doctrine packs (MIT-licensed adversarial test suites by agent class)
  - Cross-vendor pack format specification
  - Public Defendable Agent Deed schema (DDEED-DOV-*)
  - ENS-anchored agent identity standard
  - Reproducible attestation methodology

## Roadmap (versioned)

  v0 · LIVE     Market intelligence + brand-stack doctrine (already public)
  v1 · Q3 2026  Pack registry public launch
  v2 · Q4 2026  Defendable Deed schema open specification
  v3 · Q1 2027  DefendableHack bounty program
  v4 · 2027     Standards-body governance (advisory board · RFC process)

## Six permanent principles

  01  Open weights forever · MIT-attribution licensed
  02  Reproducible attestation · every claim verifiable from public artifacts
  03  Cross-vendor portability · works with any agent framework
  04  Contributor-graded · RFC process · community-reviewed PRs
  05  Receipt every claim · hyperlinks · versioned · no marketing-grade rounding
  06  Validator-of-validators · we grade the graders themselves

## Get involved

  - Submit doctrine pack PR: github.com/SudoSuOps
- Review deed JSON spec: defendableos.com/how-it-works#deed
  - Join advisory board: defense@defendableos.com
  - Read market intelligence: defendableos.com/opendefense

## Defendable brand stack · canonical v0.1.0 (2026-05-25)

The DefendableOS ecosystem operates as a 10-domain coordinated brand surface.
This canonical block supersedes all prior brand-stack definitions across the network.

- **defendableos.com** — SYSTEM · the operating system / product
- **swarmandbee.ai** — UMBRELLA · operator firm + dataset bakery
- **opendefendable.com** — OPEN · standards body
- **defendablerouter.com** — SPINE · drop-in AI router (write-only audit rail)
- **defendablecloud.com** — COMPUTE · operator-owned private inference (128 RTX 6000 Blackwell)
- **defendableledger.com** — LEDGER · sovereign in-house books and records
- **mrdefendable.com** — FACE · principal voice / human interface
- **offensetotheshed.com** — CULTURE · doctrine + war stories
- **painintheshed.com** — MEDIA · cost-of-intelligence podcast
- **defendablehack.com** — DEV · researcher / hacker tier

Legacy / superseded (not part of v0.1.0):
- ledger.mrdefendable.com → now defendableledger.com
- chat.mrdefendable.com → deprecated
- defendabledocs.com → consolidated into defendableos.com
